verdict.rationale: PostHog's own docs say users can build funnel insights on their events, save them to dashboards, share them and set alerts. Funnels can also be run from MCP clients. However, the evidence is a one-line feature mention that never describes multi-step configuration, filters, breakdowns or drop-off analysis. Missing for 10: documentation of multi-step funnel construction, property filters and breakdowns on funnels, drop-off/conversion visualization, independent or hands-on corroboration.
